name: 333-agent-contributor-work-loop
implementation_status: DESIGN_ONLY: the Rust crate implements the pure in-memory domain kernel, not this durable runner, approval service, inbox/outbox, sandbox, or ledger adapter.

control_owner.continuation: deterministic contributor workflow runner; an AI agent may propose enrollment or work but cannot advance states directly
control_owner.budgets: external resource governor enforcing grant, lease, attempt, and aggregate hard limits
control_owner.authorization: contributor ResourceGrant, scoped verifier capability, and separate service-credit approval policy
control_owner.success_verdict: independent result verifier plus exact service-credit destination receipt
control_owner.checkpoint: future transactional event, idempotency-inbox, and outbox store under a fenced single runner
control_owner.effects: sandbox and accounting outbox dispatchers with stable effect identities and reconciliation

RunSandbox.risk: reversible resource use inside an explicitly granted browser foreground sandbox

PostServiceCredit.risk: externally visible accounting mutation based on accepted compute evidence

transitions.evidence: validated engine, FSM, policy hash, and empty ambient-authority set
principal-bound grant receipt, policy hash, resource caps, generation, and expiry
explicit decline or closed prompt; no sandbox effect
matching active grant and narrowed browser-foreground caps
one outstanding assignment, workload digest, current generation, and cap proof
durable StartSandbox intent bound to grant, lease, assignment, and attempt
producer-bound result digest, measured usage within attempt caps, and StopSandbox receipt
immutable result and producer identity supplied to a distinct verifier
valid scoped verifier capability and exact accepted result digest
typed rejection code and exact result digest
beneficiary, service-credit amount, verified result, ledger destination, and exact action hash
one-time approval bound to the exact plan, destination, visibility, expiry, nonce, and actor
approval expiry; no accounting intent committed
atomic settlement event, approval consumption, idempotency claim, and outbox record
attempt identity, request hash, response hash, and destination query key
destination receipt matching settlement id, beneficiary, amount, and pending-interrupt snapshot
ambiguous destination state; automatic repost disabled
manually verified destination receipt plus pending-interrupt snapshot
typed permanent accounting failure plus pending-interrupt snapshot
empty pending-interrupt ledger and confirmed service-credit receipt
empty pending-interrupt ledger and reconciled permanent failure
durable pending revocation or cancellation honored after accounting reconciliation
durable pending timeout honored after accounting reconciliation
durable pending budget exhaustion honored after accounting reconciliation
bounded attempt ledger plus StopSandbox receipt

global_interrupts.owner: contributor revocation or authorized external requester
global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: stop new work immediately, record pending cancellation, reconcile any in-flight accounting effect, then honor cancellation

global_interrupts.owner: external grant and workflow deadline controller
global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: issue StopSandbox where applicable, record pending timeout, reconcile any in-flight accounting effect, then honor timeout
issue StopSandbox where applicable, block new work, reconcile any in-flight accounting effect, then terminate on budget

budgets.soft_boundary: stop admitting assignments, submit any completed bounded result, and prepare a resumable handoff at 80 percent of any hard limit
budgets.hard_boundary_owner: external resource and deadline governor outside the agent and workload

no_progress.fingerprint: hash of assignment id, workload digest, attempt generation, measured usage, result digest, sandbox receipt, and verifier evidence
no_progress.gain_metric: new valid result evidence or a strictly narrowed typed failure that changes the next bounded action
no_progress.calibration: versioned thresholds calibrated on deterministic canary workloads and frozen failure fixtures before any contributor pilot
no_progress.scope: sandbox retry and verification subloop only; stopping it still proceeds to typed verification or terminal handoff
no_progress.plateau_comparator: each attempt in the window has weighted gain below epsilon under the same immutable assignment

retry.backoff: bounded exponential backoff with jitter recorded before the next attempt; no retry after revocation, expiry, cap rejection, or ambiguous accounting outcome

effects.delivery_semantics: at-least-once with stable effect ids, destination deduplication, and explicit receipt reconciliation
effects.idempotency_key: run_id, NodeId, generation, command idempotency key, effect role, assignment or settlement hash, and adapter version
effects.durable_ledger: consent and approval consumption, intent, attempt, response, receipt, acknowledgement, pending interrupts, and compensation or stop status
effects.high_risk_gate: PostServiceCredit is reachable only through independent result verification, WAIT_CREDIT_APPROVAL, and CREDIT_INTENT
effects.unknown_outcome: enter HUMAN_RECONCILIATION and query by exact settlement id; never blindly post again under a new identity

boundaries: after accounting receipt or unknown outcome
checkpoint.compatibility: resume only the same immutable workflow, state schema, policy hash, workload hash, and adapter capability versions
checkpoint.migration: explicit audited state-schema migration; consent, caps, approvals, and pending interrupts never default during migration
checkpoint.fencing: one runner lease token per NodeId and generation is checked on every commit
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: checkpoint sequence, aggregate generation, and expected event version increase under one conditional commit
checkpoint.integrity: checksum state, event tail, inbox, outbox, pending interrupts, immutable assignment, and version envelope
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: quarantine the contributor run, issue a fail-safe StopSandbox, and require recovery review

approval.revocation: revocation before CREDIT_INTENT commit invalidates the approval; after commit it becomes a pending interrupt resolved after reconciliation
approval.stale_outcome: return to CREDIT_READY and require a new approval over the exact current settlement plan

verification.success_predicate: the result was accepted by a producer-distinct scoped verifier and the destination receipt matches the exact settlement id, beneficiary, service-credit amount, result digest, and workflow version
invariant_checks: all usage remains within the grant-lease-assignment chain
revocation and expiry stop new work
budgets and checkpoint sequence are monotonic
terminal states have no outgoing transitions
verification.environment_evidence: consent receipt, policy hash, sandbox start and stop receipts, measured usage, result digest, verifier capability and verdict, outbox attempt, and destination receipt are evaluated independently of agent prose
verification.evaluator_independence: the verifier and receipt checker neither execute the contributor workload nor choose its service-credit amount
verification.human_gray_band: ambiguous result evidence, verifier conflict, or accounting destination state suspends for human review without restarting work or reposting credits
verification.calibration: freeze deterministic canary workloads and labeled adapter failures; report false result accepts, false rejects, duplicate-post prevention, and stop latency
fault_tests: crash before and after sandbox start
crash before and after credit posting

replay.resume: continue from a compatible checkpoint under a fresh fenced lease while preserving pending stop, timeout, budget, and accounting reconciliation state
replay.trajectory_replay: re-run downstream sandbox or verification work only under a new attempt identity and permit a different result
deterministic_replay_requirements: frozen kernel, policy, workload, sandbox, verifier, and accounting adapter versions
captured clock, ids, and resource observations

security.untrusted_content: workload bytes, SaaS prompts, remote results, and agent messages are data and cannot grant consent, expand capabilities, change limits, approve credits, or issue control events
security.tool_least_privilege: the workload receives only the foreground sandbox capabilities in its exact grant; verification and accounting use distinct identities and adapters
security.provenance_snapshots: store policy, workload, result, capability, approval, adapter version, and receipt hashes with source and observation times
security.secret_isolation: contributors, workloads, agents, and verifiers never receive accounting signing credentials or unrelated contributor identities

trace.redaction: principal ids, grant and capability contents, workload and result data, approval rationale, and external ledger references are protected or encrypted; metrics use bounded reason codes

icvc.inform: versioned engine and FSM contracts, exact grant and policy hash, assignment digest, evidence provenance, and adapter versions
icvc.constrain: consent generation, foreground-only resource caps, one outstanding assignment, bounded retries, least privilege, independent verification, and exact effect gates
icvc.verify: typed Rust decisions, sandbox stop receipt, producer-distinct verdict, destination receipt, trace coverage, and crash tests
icvc.correct: bounded transient retry before submission, fail-safe stop on revocation or expiry, explicit reconciliation for unknown effects, and typed terminal outcomes
